summary:
[  edit  ]
The MIDI  Event   DAT  logs all  MIDI  messages coming into or out of TouchDesigner from all MIDI In/Out operators. Note: no messages will be logged if there are no active MIDI In or Out operators set to receive them. It outputs columns in a table format: message, type, channel, index, value.
The table is FIFO "first-in first-out" and limited to parameter-set number of lines. An optional script may be run for each packet received.
Also note that the controller indices reported by the MIDI  Event   DAT  are always converted to the 1 based range 1-128.
See also the  MIDI In DAT ,  MIDI In Map CHOP ,  MIDI In CHOP ,  MIDI Out CHOP ,  Tscript   midi()  Command.

parameters.label: Active
parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Logs MIDI events when turned on.

parameters.label: Skip Sense
parameters.name: skipsense
parameters.description: Does not log sense messages when this is turned on.

parameters.label: Skip Timing
parameters.name: skiptiming
parameters.description: Does not report timing messages when this is turned on.

parameters.label: Filter Messages
parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Turning this on enables the message filtering parameters below.

parameters.label: Message
parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Filter by the MIDI message content. Example "Control Change"

parameters.label: Channel
parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Filter by the MIDI message channel.	Channels range from 1 to 16.

parameters.label: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Filter by the MIDI message index. Indices range from 1 to 128.

parameters.label: Value
parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Filter by the MIDI message value. Values range from 0 to 127.

parameters.label: Dir
parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: Filter by the message direction, "input" or "output".

parameters.label: Callbacks  DAT
parameters.name: callbacks
parameters.description: Runs this script once for each row added to the table (ie. MIDI event recieved). See  midieventDAT_Class  for usage.

parameters.label: Execute from
parameters.name: executeloc
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines the location the script is run from.

parameters.label: Current  Node
parameters.name: current
parameters.description: The script is executed from the current node location.

parameters.label: Callbacks  DAT
parameters.name: callbacks
parameters.description: The script is executed from the location of the  DAT  specified in the  Callbacks  DAT   parameter.

parameters.label: Specified  Operator
parameters.name: op
parameters.description: The script is executed from the operator specified in the  From  Operator   parameter below.

parameters.label: From  Operator
parameters.name: fromop
parameters.description: The operator whose state change will trigger the  DAT  to execute its script when  Execute  is set to  Specified  Operator  . This operator is also the path that the script will be executed from if the  Execute From  parameter is set to  Specified  Operator  .

parameters.label: Clamp Output
parameters.name: clamp
parameters.description: The  DAT  is limited to 100 messages by default but with Clamp Output, this can be set to anything including unlimited.

parameters.label: Maximum Lines
parameters.name: maxlines
parameters.description: Limits the number of messages, older messages are removed from the list first.

parameters.label: Clear Output
parameters.name: clear
parameters.description: Deletes all lines except the heading. To clear with a python script  op( "opname" ).par.clear.pulse()

parameters.label: Bytes Column
parameters.name: bytes
parameters.description: Outputs the raw bytes of the message in a separate column.

parameters.label: Input

parameters.label: Node

parameters.label: Events are single
parameters.description: moment occurrences that are generated from a variety of conditions - from input actions that a user causes, from external devices and software, and from internal TouchDesigner states. A wide set of operator types respond to events and give the user a place to write python code that reacts to events.

parameters.label: An  Operator Family  that manipulates text strings: multi
parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.
